name: Sam Braaten

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single-story residence with a gray multi-gable roof|A paved driveway leads to the front of the house and garage area|Multiple vehicles are parked in the driveway|Dense mature trees surround much of the structure|Open ground and landscaped areas are present around the house|The property is located in a semi-rural setting.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence shows a single-story light-colored home with a gray roof and attached garage|A paved driveway holds multiple vehicles|Dense trees frame one side of the property|Open ground and landscaping are present near the front of the structure.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows the side elevation of the light-colored home|Outdoor items and bins are present near the structure|Open ground and a curved landscaped edge are visible|Dense trees continue around portions of this side.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence shows the back elevation of the home|An open patio area with outdoor furniture and a circular fire pit feature is present|Dense trees surround much of the rear yard|The driveway and vehicles are partially visible from this angle.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the side of the home partially screened by dense trees|Portions of the roof and driveway are visible|Open ground and landscaped areas continue around this side of the property.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway that leads from the road to the front of the residence and garage. The front of the property is open and offers space for emergency vehicle staging. Dense mature trees surround much of the sides and rear of the structure and may limit visibility and movement in those areas. Open ground near the driveway and rear patio provides additional staging space. The property has a semi-rural layout.
